about_the_game:
Re-Activated is a 2D puzzle platformer game where you need to manipulate the movement system of a robot to pass the levels. You control the little flying robot named “Minic” to help the robot. Explore the facility and solve the puzzles in a relaxing 1-bit style atmosphere.

You play as a little robot called "Minic" to help the bigger robot to pass the levels. The big robot's only function is to walk and stop. As Minic and the big robot pass the levels, new functions in the big robot's movement system unlocks. As a Minic, your purpose is to combine these functions cleverly to solve puzzles.

To use these functions, there is a plugboard of the big robot's brain. There are inputs and outputs. Inputs have a jack that connects to the cable and outputs have a jack socket. You can connect those jacks to sockets to manipulate the movement system of the big robot. There are multiple inputs and multiple outputs. That creates multiple combinations of movement systems. It's your call to choose which one of the combinations is a better choice for every level.

Explore the 40+ levels in a facility of robots in a relaxing 1-bit pixel art style with great lighting effects in pixel perfect game.
